title: BEYOND CHATGPT: THE NEXT EVOLUTION OF AI

items.abstract: <jats:p>Artificial intelligence is moving from tools that assist human users to AI agents that can plan, execute, monitor, and escalate tasks across business workflows. This shift has significant implications for finance, accounting, audit, and internal control environments. If traditional automation improved speed, AI agents may reshape how organizations detect exceptions, manage reconciliations, prepare management reports, monitor compliance, and support decision making. This paper argues that AI agents should be understood not merely as productivity tools but as emerging control infrastructure that must be governed, tested, and supervised. Using a structured review of internal control, AI risk management, and finance transformation literature, the paper proposes an Agent to Assurance Control Chain linking data quality, agent design, human oversight, exception escalation, control evidence, and stakeholder confidence. The paper also presents a Finance Professional AI Knowledge Readiness Index and an AI Agent Control Maturity Model. The conclusion is that finance professionals must invest deliberately in AI knowledge because agentic AI will increasingly influence reporting quality, internal controls, investor confidence, and broader economic value.</jats:p>
title: AI Agents as the Next Control Frontier Internal Controls, Financial Governance, and Professional Knowledge Investment in the Age of Agentic AI
